destroy_rule.callee: Every delete is the sized operator delete PLT stub 0x5660440 (_ZdlPvm); the only other call in the function is the self-call.
per_node: If [node+0x28] != node+0x38 (heap arm): sized delete of [node+0x28] with size [node+0x38] + 1 (capacity + 1, the heap buffer plus its terminator).
Otherwise (SSO arm): no buffer delete; the buffer is the node's own +0x38 bytes.
Then sized delete of the node itself with size 0x48.
destroy_rule.traversal: Post-order destroy_list: for each node in the +0x10 sibling chain, destroy the whole +0x18 child list first (each child with its own subtree), then destroy the node, then move to the next sibling. A null head destroys nothing and returns immediately.
destroy_rule.unrolling: The first-child descent is unrolled 7 links deep (ancestor slots: stack +0x10, r14, r15, rbx, rbp, r12, r13); deeper levels go through the self-call, so the traversal depth is unbounded, not 7.
